BiblicalUsage: We is the Hebrew word for us, the voice of the remnant answering Jeremiah: we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, whether it be good or whether it be evil. The word is the people's own answer, spoken together.
TheologicalSignificance: A pronoun carries no doctrine of its own; its poignancy is the remnant's, that they promised to obey and then did the opposite.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
